title: Identifiability of finite-state $ε$-machines from finite summaries
summary: We study how much observable finite-dimensional information is sufficient to identify a finite-state generator $ε$-machine. The observable summaries are labeled tables of conditional probabilities given finite histories and contiguous block laws. For stationary ergodic finite-alphabet processes, we first prove that a table with past horizon $L$ and future horizon $R$ is equivalent to the block law of length $L+R$.
